sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Bukijutsu, Water Release, Wind Release

system.description:
You collect Water particles from the air and freeze them into daggers made of ice and throw them at a target. Make a ranged ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack dealing 4d6 cold damage on a hit

If this jutsu is cast while you occupy an Ice Mirror, on a hit, the affected creature must make a Constitution saving throw, gaining a rank of Frostbite on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of Frostbite inflicted by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of Frostbite inflicted by +1.
